snippet.title: Anime “Dragon Ball Super: Beerus” | Super Surge Trailer
snippet.description:
The God of Destruction Beerus, Frieza, and now —
A new threat closing in on Earth, stands in the way of Goku and his allies.

October 2026
Broadcasting and streaming begins!
The anime Dragon Ball Super, original work, story, and character design by Akira Toriyama, is set to begin anew as Dragon Ball Super: Beerus!

#dragonball #dragonballsuper

◾️Anime “Dragon Ball Super: Beerus” | SUPER Launch Trailer
https://youtu.be/OOmRInABehI

◾️Anime “Dragon Ball Super: Beerus” | SUPER GEKITOU Trailer
https://youtu.be/-NekKfJN614

◾️INTRODUCTION
The globally beloved manga DRAGON BALL by Akira Toriyama continues to captivate fans through a wide range of media—from TV animation, movies, games, and merchandising—standing as a top-ranked title with extraordinary worldwide popularity. 
Now, in 2026, the anime Dragon Ball Super, original work, story, and character design by Akira Toriyama, is set to begin anew as Dragon Ball Super: Beerus! This ENHANCED edition introduces a large volume of newly added and redrawn cuts, as well as a reconstructed narrative. With cutting-edge visual expression, the series delivers even more immersive battle scenes and a more faithful representation of the original manga—bringing an ENHANCED edition to life like never before.

Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep. Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus’s overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku.
Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an Earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his allies—a conflict that will shake the entire universe.


Original Work, Story & Character Design: Akira Toriyama
Composition and Direction Arrangement: Matsuto Seya
Animation Character Design & General Animation Director: Tadayoshi Yamamuro
Editing: Eichi Nishimura
Compositing Director: Yosuke Motoki
Music: Norihito Sumitomo

OPENING THEME　"ONOGAMI"　MEGATERA･ZERO
ENDING THEME　"Kan Peki No Peki"　VK Blanka

Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu (Andrew Koji) and Ken Masters (Noah Centineo) are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li (Callina Liang) recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don’t, it’s GAME OVER!

Hello DDR's (Dedicated Description Readers)!

I'm not sure what to write... there's SO MUCH going on but I really can't talk about any of it right now... Basically, the channel is pivoting a bit. We'll still do "fandom music," but we have three MAJOR projects in the works, and they're all either original IP or colabs.

Fan music is fun! We love supporting the IP's we love, but fandoms, as most of you probably know, can be challenging.
After our Insane music video got taken down a second time, we decided to reevaluate the channel a bit. We really can't afford to spend thousands of dollars and months of our time on a project if we don't know whether or not it's going to get copyright claimed and taken down before it can even recoup the cost.

Without going too in depth, we actually commissioned the Insane music video because Nate and his family were dealing with a very serious medical situation. Their medical bills were extremely high and this music video seemed like a good way to bring in a bit more income without him needing to be away from his family to create new content. They are doing much better now, which is why he gave me the OK to share this, but it was scary for a long time and they are still not completely out of the woods yet. That being said, if you have the time, he requests that you send your thoughts and prayers to him and his family.

I'm not trying to make you to feel sorry for us. We're doing fine! But I feel it's only fair to give you a bit of a heads-up that we are going to be trying some new things to try to keep the channel going. We're working VERY hard to make these projects some of the best we've ever made, and we REALLY hope you love them! Stay tuned…

Love you all!

~Gabe

snippet.title: GTA 6 Is A Game Made For Stupid People
snippet.description:
The hype around Rockstar Games's GTA 6 and its new extended look trailer has gotten completely ridiculous. Although a lot of people are acting like this is going to be the greatest game ever made, the trailer shows off a shockingly small amount of gameplay, and what gameplay is there looks incredibly boring. I would wager this is another case of "realism" and "details" being prioritized over fun gameplay, and a lot of players are blinded by the hype.

After a fatal shooting on the job leaves his career hanging by a thread, LAPD S.W.A.T. Sergeant Daniel “Hondo” Harrelson is forced into retirement, in retaliation for refusing to bury the truth. Two years later, he’s back, tasked with building a new tactical unit from the department’s most talented outcasts. The team, soon named the Exiles, includes a live-streaming hotshot, a socially awkward tech genius, a fiercely disciplined operator with something to prove, a wildcard with a troubled past, and a strategist with a hidden agenda. As the squad finds its footing under fire, Hondo uncovers something far more dangerous than any street threat: a mole in his ranks, and a conspiracy reaching into the LAPD’s top brass and the Mayor’s office; one built to tear S.W.A.T. apart from within.

snippet.title: They Saw a Horrifying Creature in 1973... But Was It Real?
snippet.description:
Welcome to Tales of Fear Episode Zero full gameplay! Can you tell the difference between truth and tale? Experience three short horror stories and gather clues as to which are true and which are just part of our imagination. Thanks to @MediaTale for the early access game key!

Follow Me Here:
➜ http://instagram.com/thefoosterchannel 
➜ Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/thafooster

Need a Server?
10% Off G-Portal Servers ➜ https://www.g-portal.com/?ref=Fooster
If you use this link it supports me directly so thank you!

ABOUT TALES OF FEAR:
Tales of Fear is a first-person horror adventure featuring playable retellings of various horror stories. Some of them are fictional, while others are based on real events, and it's up to you to figure out which ones are true.
Take on the role of the protagonist in each narrative and experience unique stories. Explore immersive, handcrafted locations on your own and encounter some frightening surprises along the way.

Case 01 - Enfield Encounter
Patrick McKelvy's relaxed evening turns out to be a dangerous nightmare that he is forced to endure while fearing for his life. He encounters a creature that does not exist in any history book and causes great chaos in his city.

Case 02 - Alice and Bob
An employee of a large tech company takes on a night shift with his colleague that will haunt him for a long time afterward. An experiment in artificial intelligence is supposed to take the company to the next level. When his coworker suddenly has an emergency, he is left alone with the experiment. It goes well, too well, until he loses control of the AI models.

Case 03 - Doai Station
Kaito, a freelance journalist chasing a rumor at Mount Tanigawa, decides to take the last train home. As the train arrives, he is on the phone with his brother, Haru, when the connection suddenly breaks. While waiting for Kaito's arrival, Haru becomes anxious, only to find out that the last train from Doai Station had already left hours before the phone call.

Game Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4191350/Tales_of_Fear__Episode_Zero/

snippet.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker - Part 1 - A New Open World Vampire Game
snippet.description:
The Blood of Dawnwalker Gameplay Walkthrough Part 1 (Full Game) This series includes the full game story walkthrough of The Blood of Dawnwalker and its open world from beginning to ending. The Blood of Dawnwalker first impressions, all cutscenes, boss fights, weapons, and reactions.

Thank You Bandai Namco for the early copy to this game!

14th-century Europe. Bloody conflicts sweep the lands, and the Black Death comes for the survivors. It's a moment of weakness - and that's all they needed. Vampires seize their opportunity to walk out of the shadows and claim what they've been denied for centuries: freedom, and the power that comes with it. Other creatures of the night follow their lead. Legends turn into reality, and history as we know it will never be the same.

You play as Coen, a young man turned into a Dawnwalker, forever treading the line between the world of day and the realm of night. Fight for your humanity or embrace the cursed powers to save your family. Whatever your choice, the question stands: is your soul worth the lives of those you love?

localized.description:
The Blood Of Dawnwalker Walkthrough Part 1 and until the last part will include the full The Blood Of Dawnwalker Gameplay on PS5 Pro. This The Blood Of Dawnwalker Gameplay is recorded in 4K 60FPS on PS5 Pro and will include the full game, all endings and all boss fights. 

Enjoy!

If you liked the video please remember to leave a Like & Comment, I appreciate it a lot!

The Blood of Dawnwalker is an open-world dark fantasy action RPG set in 14th-century Europe. You play as Coen, human by day and vampire by night, fighting to save your family in a story shaped by your actions and the secrets you uncover. Experience two different gameplay loops, offering distinct abilities to choose from, mysteries to uncover, and varying ways to achieve your goals. Experiment with different approaches and discover how the world reacts to your actions.

snippet.title: New Rumors reveal SONY may finally Admit Defeat...
snippet.description:
New Gaming News! After Support Ended for Destiny 2, and abandoning Physical Games Discs, the SONY Backlash has been Immense! And New Rumors from Gamescom 2026 seem to indicate that SONY may Reverse it's recent Decisions! Has the PlayStation Backlash worked? Let's Discuss! 
--FOLLOW ME ON TWITCH: https://www.twitch.tv/kackishd

--- My Twitter: https://twitter.com/RickKackis

New #gamingnews video, going over the Gamescom 2026 Rumors that SONY may be reversing it's recent decisions! This is after the latest Destiny 2 News about the Next Destiny 2 Monument of Triumph (June Update) with Destiny 2 Ending, after the Launch of the New Destiny 2 Renegades Expansion! Monument of Triumph is here and we have the Destiny 2 News from the New TWAB (This week at Bungie) or TWID (This Week in Destiny) for June 18th, during Destiny 2 Monument of Triumph! This is after Destiny 2: Renegades, and The Edge of Fate DLC.
The Renegades Expansion brought a new Campaign, and the "Lawless Frontiers" Activity! Pledge to the different Syndicates (Totality Division, The Pikers, or Tharsis Reformation), and complete Bounties in the Lawless Frontier, secure Contested Zones, and fend off Invaders! Get the new Praxic Blade Exotic Sword (Destiny 2 Lightsaber), and play the new Equilibrium Dungeon! 
But now We have the Monument Of Triumph! The Last Destiny 2 Update Ever! It brings Pantheon 2.0 (Calus Resplendent and Morgeth Surpassing) As well as Updated Destinations, New Exotic Catalysts, the new Secret Exotic Quest and Secret Exotic Mission for the Cull's Shadow, Sparrow Racing League (SRL), and more!
But today we're going over the new gaming news! After all of the Destiny 2 stuff, and the Bungie Layoffs, Sony Physical Games are ending, and players are furious! SONY has completely ruined it's reputation as the SONY backlash and PlayStation backlash are absolutely insane. And now rumors from Gamescom indicate sony may actually reverse course with Physical Discs!? Heck, maybe they'll even announce destiny 3 to win players back lol Let's talk about it!
#gaming #PlayStation

snippet.title: So Germany Finally Got Updated In Kaiserredux (& It's Perfect) - HOI4
snippet.description:
So today we are checking out Kaiserredux' new Germany rework, surely this time he wont go full Kaiser? (spoilers I don't)

You can find more from iSorrowproductions HERE:

MERCH: https://isorrowproductions.com/
Discord: https://www.discord.gg/isp
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ispuuuv
Instagram @uuuvstuff

We are checking out the Kaiserredux Germany rework to see if these new focus' can actually hold up. 

This playthrough focuses on the updated focus trees and internal political mechanics that define the current Germany experience. We run through the primary strategic decisions available for the Swedish State and analyze how these changes impact the broader economic landscape of the game. It is a look at how to balance your internal stability while managing external alignment in a shifting geopolitical environment.

By testing out these specific focus trees, you can decide if the current political management style suits your playstyle or if it is just another way to run a campaign into the ground. We compare the new diplomatic options against the old standards to see if these adjustments provide enough depth for a serious run.

Subscribe for weekly strategy game breakdowns, and comment which nation you want to see me play next.
